verdict.rationale: Token2 provides a dedicated bulk-enrollment tool (fido2_bulkenroll_entraid) that automates registering FIDO2 keys in Microsoft Entra ID via the Graph API, including setting random PINs and logging results, plus PowerShell/GraphAPI automated registration guides and an audit/export function that dumps device info and relying parties to JSON/CSV across devices. These support bulk operations on many keys/devices, but they are admin/scripting tools rather than AI-native agent-driven automation, and there's no evidence of natural-language or agent-callable bulk interfaces (e.g., API/CLI designed for AI agents). Missing for 10: AI-agent-oriented interface/API for bulk actions, independent verification of bulk enrollment at scale, and evidence of bulk operations beyond FIDO2/Entra ID enrollment.
